correctness.rationale: For each disjoint pair of edges e_ij×e_kℓ, identify its integral basis element with (i,k)⊗(j,ℓ). Product cellular boundary has four disjoint face families imposing exactly d_p⊗id and id⊗d_q kernels. Incidence images of connected crowns are saturated over Z, so direct-summand splitting proves the simultaneous kernel is L_p⊗L_q integrally. Product orientation gives particle sign minus and bipartition swap no sign. Character traces follow from the incidence/cokernel exact sequence. Exact checker independently constructs cellular boundaries and cycle bases and compares 4176 signed Lefschetz values; finite tests corroborate the all-size argument.
